set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-video.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: AC4-S1 is closed; frame planning and SampledFrameSet types do not prove executed correspondence. Complete request/selection binding first.

Remaining / next action: Execute exact-presentation-ordinal extraction per part and prove emitted frame ordinal/PTS correspondence to PacketIndex using synthetic media. Retain the frozen Sherlock AV arm and label the old sidecar path legacy.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF per T1. Acceptance: the extractor emits SampledFrameSet-shaped frames per part by exact presentation ordinal (ffmpeg select on streaming decode, not -ss) plus envelopes; an executed synthetic witness links each emitted frame's ordinal and PTS to the PacketIndex, with selection and any transformation recorded; the bench sidecar is documented LEGACY and the frozen Sherlock-dev AV arm is untouched. Depends on AC4-S1.
